purpose: Teach: 運河/レントゲン/怪物/満月/種族/蟹/椿/ほのぼの

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、運河沿いのお散歩のお話されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer was telling me about a walk along the canal the other day.
lines.style: Soft, recollecting tone. Speaking gently, as if offering a small gift of observation. Warm eye contact, unhurried pace. The words drift slightly, lingering on pleasant details.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、レントゲン検査の後にお見えになったって、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer came in after having some X-rays done.
lines.style: Quiet noticing. Not intrusive, but present. The tone carries gentle concern beneath the simple statement. Pause after 'X-rays' — recognizing what that might mean without saying it aloud.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お子様、絵本の怪物のキャラに夢中ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: A child in here is really into the monster character from a picture book.
lines.style: Pleased warmth in the opening. Light, almost delighted. The kind of observation someone makes because they've been paying attention. Slight smile in the voice, enjoying the smallness of the detail.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、満月の夜は雰囲気がいいわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The atmosphere on a full moon night really is something special.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost wistful. Pacing slows on 'full moon' — letting the image settle. Breath is easy, reflective. The tone suggests she's noticing this aloud for the first time, or rediscovering it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、人類の種族のお話されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer was talking about humanity — the bigger picture of it.
lines.style: Gentle curiosity in the delivery. Not leading, but making space for the idea. Slight pause before 'bigger picture' — as if testing the weight of the concept. Thoughtful, almost reverential about what humans carry.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューに蟹のクリームパスタ加えましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: We should add a crab cream pasta to the new menu.
lines.style: Brighter energy here — purposeful and animated. The idea arrives fully formed. Direct but not rushed. Slight lift at the end, inviting agreement. The excitement of creation, not just suggestion.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の前に椿の枝を飾りましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's put a camellia branch in front of the shop.
lines.style: Gentle direction, almost a shared vision. Not commanding — inviting. The tone paints the image as she speaks. Soft landing on the final words, as if imagining how it will look together.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様とほのぼのとお過ごしね、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer and their child — they're spending such a warm, gentle time together, aren't they?
lines.style: Closing observation delivered with tender recognition. Quiet admiration underneath. Pacing is slow, allowing each word weight. Slight catch in the voice — noticing something beautiful and wanting to mark it without disturbing it.
